name: toolsapps
description: Konversi berkas & media, offline-first untuk desktop dan Android.

scripts.build: npm -w @toolsapps/web run build && npm -w @toolsapps/server run build && npm -w @toolsapps/desktop run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @toolsapps/web run typecheck && npm -w @toolsapps/server run typecheck && npm -w @toolsapps/desktop run typecheck
scripts.dist:win: npm -w @toolsapps/web run build && npm -w @toolsapps/desktop run dist
scripts.dist:win:unsigned: npm -w @toolsapps/web run build && npm -w @toolsapps/desktop run dist:unsigned
scripts.android:sync: npm -w @toolsapps/web run build && npm -w @toolsapps/web run cap:sync
scripts.android:build: npm -w @toolsapps/web run build && npm -w @toolsapps/web run cap:sync && node scripts/build-android.mjs
